assignment_preview_description: Type “{type}” will be assigned to the selected stock locations.
authorized_groups_help: Members of these groups can change already protected locations using standard InvenTree editing, subject to stock permissions and ownership restrictions.
bulk_assignment_description: Assign types to existing stock locations in bulk. Protection applies automatically by type.
bulk_complete_summary: Completed in {seconds}s. Changed: {changed}. Already had the type: {unchanged}.
bulk_operation_timeout_help: This does not move locations or change their contents. Large batches may take more than 5 seconds. If a request times out, check current types before retrying.
bulk_protection_note: Changes are applied in one transaction. After assigning a protected type, ordinary users cannot remove it or move that stock location.
bulk_timeout_warning: Request timed out. The server might have completed the operation! Do not retry before refreshing the list and checking actual location types.
create_types_bulk_instructions: Create stock location types using InvenTree’s built-in tools. Select locations, choose a type and confirm the bulk operation.
error_bulk_panel_permission: Bulk management is available only to administrators or authorized groups
error_change_protected_type: Changing a protected type is denied. Administrator or authorized group permission is required.
error_location_ownership: Insufficient permissions for one of the selected locations
error_locations_not_found: One or more locations were not found
error_move_into_descendant: Cannot move a location into itself or its descendant
error_protected_move_permission: Missing special permission to move protected locations
error_protected_relocation: Relocation denied: this location or its descendants have a protected type. Administrator or authorized group permission is required.
error_protected_type_special_permission: Changing an existing protected type requires special permission:
error_settings_superuser_only: Protection settings are available to superusers only
error_stock_change_permission: Missing standard InvenTree permission to change StockLocation
error_too_many_locations: Too many locations for the management panel (limit: 2000)
error_type_does_not_exist: The specified type does not exist
first_assignment_permissions: Assigning a protected type for the first time is governed by standard InvenTree permissions.
full_path_search_warning: Important: searching the full path for “Rack” will also find boxes inside racks. To select racks only, search the Name field.
hidden_selection_warning: Warning: {count} selected locations are hidden by the current filter but remain selected.
name: Name
name_search_selection_note: By default, search includes names only. Manually checked rows remain selected across filters.
path_unavailable: Path no longer available — refresh the data
protected_type_permission_note: Changing protected types requires special permission
protected_types_help: Choose the types whose parent and subsequent type changes require special permission.
regex_alternation_description: Matches either rack or shelf; parentheses are optional
regex_box_numbers_description: Box 1, 2 or 3 at the end of the name
regex_grouped_alternatives_description: Name begins with either word; parentheses group alternatives
regex_numbered_rack_description: Entire name: “Rack”, space and one or more digits
regex_search_help: Plain search matches text literally. Enable “Regex /i” for case-insensitive regular expressions. Only checked fields are searched; matching across fields uses OR.
regex_shelf_position_description: Shelf, followed by any text, then “top” or “bottom”
regex_symbols_help: Symbols: ^ start, $ end, | OR, (...) group, .* any text, [0-9] digit, + one or more, ? optional. Do not include surrounding /.../ slashes.
selected_locations_details: Selected stock locations (full path and ID):
selection_replacement_warning: The “Select matching only” button will replace the entire selection.
settings_saved: Protection settings saved. All locations with the selected types are now protected.
shortcut_visibility_note: Hiding the navigation entry or dashboard widget does not change permissions or disable protection. The panel remains available through its direct URL.
